## Annex B

## FORM FOR REQUESTING MEDICAL RECORDS

## Annex C

## TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] C1 Letter of Notification

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Letter of Notification

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Re: [Claimant’s Name, Address, DoB and NHS Number]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] We have been instructed to act on behalf of [Claimant’s name] in relation to treatment carried out/care provided at [name of hospital or treatment centre] by [name of clinician(s) if known] on [insert date(s)]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] The purpose of this letter is to notify you that, although we are not yet in a position to serve a formal Letter of Claim, our initial investigations indicate that a case as to breach of duty and/or causation has been identified. We therefore invite you to commence your own investigation and draw your attention to the fact that failure to do may be taken into account when considering the reasonableness of any subsequent application for an extension of time for the Letter of Response. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] We understand that you are the correct defendant in respect of treatment provided by [name of clinician] at [hospital/surgery/treatment centre] on [date(s)]. If you do not agree, please provide us with any information you have that may assist us to identify the correct defendant. Failure to do so may result in costs sanctions should proceedings be issued. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Summary of Facts and Alleged Adverse Outcome

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] [Outline what is alleged to have happened and provide a chronology of events with details of relevant known treatment/care.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] [Provide index of records obtained and request for further records/information if required.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Allegations of Negligence

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] [Brief outline of any alleged breach of duty and causal link with any damage suffered.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Expert Evidence

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] [State whether expert evidence has been obtained or is awaited and, if so, the relevant discipline.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Damage

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] [Brief outline of any injuries attributed to the alleged negligence and their functional impact.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Funding

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] [If known, state method of funding and whether arrangement was entered into before or after April 2013.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] Rehabilitation

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > TEMPLATES FOR LETTERS OF NOTIFICATION, CLAIM AND RESPONSE] As a result of the allegedly negligent treatment, our client has injuries/needs that could be met by rehabilitation. We invite you to consider how this could be achieved. ## Limitation

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] For the purposes of limitation, we calculate that any proceedings will need to be issued on or before [date]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Please acknowledge this letter by [insert date 14 days after deemed receipt] and confirm to whom any Letter of Claim should be sent. We enclose a duplicate of the letter for your insurer. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Recoverable Benefits

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] The claimant’s National Insurance Number will be sent to you in a separate envelope. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We look forward to hearing from you. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Yours faithfully,

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] C2 Letter of Claim

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] To

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Defendant

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Dear Sirs

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Letter of Claim

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] [Claimant’s name] –v- [Defendant’s Name]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We have been instructed to act on behalf of [Claimant’s name] in relation to treatment carried out/care provided at [name of hospital or treatment centre] by [name of clinician(s) if known] on [insert date(s)]. Please let us know if you do not believe that you are the appropriate defendant or if you are aware of any other potential defendants. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Claimant’s details

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Full name, DoB, address, NHS Number. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Dates of allegedly negligent treatment

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] include chronology based on medical records. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Events giving rise to the claim:

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] an outline of what happened, including details of other relevant treatments to the client by other healthcare providers. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Allegation of negligence and causal link with injuries:

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] an outline of the allegations or a more detailed list in a complex case;

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] an outline of the causal link between allegations and the injuries complained of;

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] A copy of any supportive expert evidence (optional). [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] The Client’s injuries, condition and future prognosis

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] A copy of any supportive expert report (optional);

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Suggestions for rehabilitation;

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] The discipline of any expert evidence obtained or proposed. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Clinical records (if not previously provided)

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We enclose an index of all the relevant records that we hold. We shall be happy to provide copies of these on payment of our photocopying charges. We enclose a request for copies of the following records which we believe that you hold. We confirm that we shall be responsible for your reasonable copying charges. Failure to provide these records may result in costs sanctions if proceedings are issued. The likely value of the claim

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] an outline of the main heads of damage, or, in straightforward cases, the details of loss;

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Part 36 settlement offer (optional);

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] suggestions for ADR. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Funding

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] [State method of funding and whether arrangement was entered into before or after April 2013.]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We enclose a further copy of this letter for you to pass to your insurer. We look forward to receiving an acknowledgment of this letter within 14 days and your Letter of Response within 4 months of the date on which this letter was received. We calculate the date for receipt of your Letter of Response to be [date]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Recoverable Benefits

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] The claimant’s National Insurance Number will be sent to you in a separate envelope. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We look forward to hearing from you. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Yours faithfully

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] C3 Letter of Response

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] To

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Claimant

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Dear Sirs

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Letter of Response

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] [Claimant’s name] –v- [Defendant’s Name]

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We have been instructed to act on behalf of [defendant] in relation to treatment carried out/care provided to [claimant] at [name of hospital or treatment centre] by [name of clinician(s) if known] on [insert date(s)]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] The defendant [conveys sympathy for the adverse outcome/would like to offer an apology/denies that there was an adverse outcome]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Parties

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] It is accepted that [defendant] had a duty of care towards [claimant] in respect of [details if required] treatment/care provided to [claimant] at [location] on [date(s)]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] However, [defendant] is not responsible for [details] care/treatment provided to [claimant] at [location] on [date(s)] by [name of clinician if known]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Records

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We hold the following records…

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We require copies of the following records…

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Failure to provide these records may result in costs sanctions if proceedings are issued. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Comments on events and/or chronology:

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We [agree the chronology enclosed with the Letter of Claim] [enclose a revised chronology of events]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] We enclose copies of relevant [records/Protocols/internal investigations] in respect of the treatment/care that [claimant] received. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Liability

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] In respect of the specific allegations raised by the claimant, the defendant [has obtained an expert opinion and] responds as follows:-

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] [each allegation should be addressed separately. The defendant should explain which (if any) of the allegations of breach of duty and/or causation are admitted and why. The defendant should also make clear which allegations are denied and why]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Next Steps

[Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] The defendant suggests… [e.g. no prospect of success for the claimant, resolution without admissions of liability, ADR, settlement offer, rehabilitation]. [Pre-Action Protocol for the Resolution of Clinical Disputes Clinical Disputes Forum > Limitation] Yours faithfully,”
